objective: Establish the permanent enterprise authentication and authorization foundation: a canonical global user identity plane with normalized email and lifecycle status, an Organization membership boundary enforced in PostgreSQL, Argon2id password credentials with versioning, short-lived EdDSA access tokens with rotating server-side refresh sessions, revocation and replay detection, a provider-neutral signing-key abstraction with kid rotation and a KMS/HSM seam, organization-scoped RBAC with deny-by-default authorization, the authenticated production TenantContextResolver that completes the P02 seam, a minimal login/refresh/logout/session API with generic failures and a bounded brute-force defense seam — proven by an adversarial security test matrix, concurrency tests, hardened-environment fail-closed rules, migrations with tenant RLS, multi-architecture builds and a clean-room validation, on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
title: Security and Authentication
